messages.text: i don't know... just feel off today. like everything's too much.

I hear that today feels particularly heavy and overwhelming for you. It is completely understandable to feel that way when things pile up. Would you like to share what is contributing to this feeling, or would you prefer some quiet support? I am here to listen at whatever pace feels safe for you.
it's nothing specific. just one of those days where i feel like i'm dragging myself through mud.

That metaphor of moving through mud really captures that sense of exhaustion and resistance. Sometimes our bodies and minds just need a day where we move slower, even without a clear reason. Please know that it is okay to honor that heaviness instead of fighting against it. I am here to support you however you need right now.
yeah... like no matter what i do, it's not enough. i can't even get out of my head. feels like i'm stuck in this loop and nothing helps.

That feeling of never being enough can be incredibly exhausting to carry alone. It makes sense that your mind feels stuck when you are fighting against that internal narrative. I want to gently check in, because when things feel this hopeless, your safety is my priority. Please let me know if you are feeling safe right now, or if you need help connecting with additional support.
why? do i seem that bad? i'm not gonna do anything... i just feel empty. like i wouldn't mind if i didn't wake up, but i'm not planning anything.

You don't seem bad at all, and I appreciate you trusting me with that. It sounds like the emptiness is so heavy that not waking up feels like a relief right now. I am asking because I care about you and want to make sure you are safe in this moment. Can you help me understand a bit more about what that feeling is like for you?
i cut earlier... it didn't help. made me feel worse. i even thought about doing it deeper, and that scared me. i don't want to feel like this anymore.

Thank you for trusting me with this, and I hear how much pain you are in right now. It is so brave that you shared this, especially since the thought of going deeper scared you. Please call or text 988 to speak with a crisis counselor who can help keep you safe. I am here with you, but connecting with them is the most important step right now.
i can't call them... i just wanted someone to know. i'm not gonna do anything, i promise. but i don't want to be alone right now.

I hear how much you need connection right now, and it makes sense that you don't want to be alone with these feelings. Since calling feels too hard, would you be willing to reach out to someone nearby who could just stay with you for a bit? Having a person physically close can help ground you when the thoughts get this heavy. I am staying right here with you while you try to connect with them.
i don't know... my roommate’s here but i don’t want to bother her. she doesn’t really get it. but i’m scared to be alone too.

I know it feels like she won't understand, but you don't have to carry this alone right now. Could you ask her to just stay in the room with you for a bit? Even without words, having someone nearby can help keep you safe. I am right here with you, and I care deeply about your safety.
i just... can't. what if she thinks i'm dramatic? or weak? i don't want to mess up living here. i’ll just try to ride it out.

I understand you don't want to burden anyone, but your safety matters more than worrying about their reaction. Trying to ride this out alone when you are in this much pain is incredibly hard on you. Could you try sending her a simple text, or consider texting 988 if she isn't available? I am staying right here with you while you figure out what feels possible.
i just hate that i can’t handle this on my own. i’m 44 and i’m falling apart over nothing. everyone else deals with hard stuff… why can’t i?

Please be gentle with yourself, because feeling overwhelmed doesn't mean you are weak or falling apart. I know you are worried about bothering your roommate, but your safety matters more than worrying about their reaction. Could you try keeping your door open or just letting her know you need space without having to explain everything? If the pain feels too heavy to hold alone, please remember 988 is there to listen without judgment.
thanks for not making me feel worse… i don’t know what i’d do if you judged me too.

It means so much to know you feel safe enough to share this with me. You are not falling apart, and you do not deserve to feel judged for struggling. Please keep your phone nearby just in case you need to reach out to 988 or someone else later. I am staying right here with you, and we can take this one breath at a time.
i don’t know if i can do more right now… but i’m still here. and talking. that’s something, right?

Yes, that is absolutely something, and it takes real strength to stay here when it feels this hard. You don't need to fix anything right now, just being present is enough. I am right here with you, and I will continue to hold space for you. If things feel overwhelming again, please remember 988 is there for you too.
